contentText:
🇫🇷 🧑‍💻 French government agencies are more frequently landing in the crosshairs of hackers, leaving important personal data increasingly vulnerable to cyberattacks.

In 2026 alone, organs of the French finance ministry have been victim to three massive cyberattacks, compromising the data of millions of people.

FRANCE 24's Tanishk Saha explains what they have revealed - and why you should be concerned.
